bounds: Official persist writes registered transform2d@1.0.0 hold/linear keyframes via SetTransformKeyframe and RemoveTransformKeyframe on translateX, translateY, scaleX, scaleY, rotationDeg, anchorX, and anchorY only. This is transform keyframes (Ken Burns), not video generation, not a new Effect.type, and not a pluginVersion bump.

Semantics reuse the admitted opacity machine: clip-local times quantized to the project frame grid (KEYFRAME_NOT_ON_FRAME); at most 256 points per transform effect (TRANSFORM_KEYFRAME_LIMIT); half-open hold/linear interpolation; trim interpolates at the boundary and rebases; split clones owners and point ids; slip / dragging a clip leaves clip-local keys unchanged; InversePatch kind stays restoreSnapshot; refusals do not half-write.

Dart compiles per-frame schedules; native consumes transformFrames or a constant transform2d when every frame is identical, and does not host a second interpolator. Preview may use a single-frame evaluated transform2d. Mix/graph order remains crop → transform2d → colorBasic → opacity → dissolve.

Unknown interpolation, audio clips, and easing stay UNSUPPORTED_EDIT_TECHNIQUE (easing remains SCHEMA_TYPE where that is already the schema rule). Unregistered parameters and adapters that lack linearTransform2dKeyframesV1 stay TRANSFORM_ANIMATION_NOT_IMPLEMENTED; that code is not retargeted. Animated curves refuse static SetClipTransform with ANIMATED_TRANSFORM_REQUIRES_EXPLICIT_KEYFRAME_EDIT and do not clear keys.

Production algebra of opacity, gain, and dissolve is unchanged except that shared crop/admission helpers now also recognize admitted transform2d curves, encoderSegment emits opacityFramesQ16 only when an opacity-typed effect has keys (not any effect), and four SDK adapter checks no longer treat transform-only keys as a missing opacity adapter. I-009 algebra and gain tests were not otherwise changed.

Luma, unregistered plugins, crop/colorBasic animation, field-aware invert matrix rows, I-007 remapping/nest, I-009 volume-keyframe algebra changes, I-036 CharacterPack, Pulse/clock certification, and the V-003 render gate are not opened. Increment 1.17/1.18 stay open. I-008 stays partial; leftover remainingAcceptance items 「缺handles拒」, 「关键帧边界连续」, and 「一次提案原子undo恢复hash」 stay listed and were not re-qualified.
